test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Baskets are Canes.

Some Canes are Woods.

All Woods are Forests.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All Canes are Forests. 

(II) Some Baskets are Woods.
solution:
Statement:

Some Baskets are Canes.

Some Canes are Woods.

All Woods are Forests.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7710fb3f8e46c813bab30ff07d2cd209c51bfde21234b71c27a1262012e4e42d.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All Canes are Forests - False (Some canes are forests, but All canes are forest can be possible, not definite).

(ii) Some Baskets are Woods - False (Because no direct relation given between Baskets and Woods, so it can be possible only).

Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows..

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
